mentions.name: Rax
mentions.description: A group expense splitter for trips, dinners and events where users add shared expenses and it shows exactly how much each participant owes to each person, avoiding manual settlements. Built with React + Vite on the frontend and Firebase on the backend.
mentions.problem: Manually settling who owes what after shared expenses is tedious.
mentions.audience: People sharing expenses on trips, dinners and events.
